purpose: Teach: 憶測/押しつける/歩む/破る/取り戻し/引っ張り/とらわれ/奪う

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、市場の、絶対、憶測、絶対、注視しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need this company to watch market speculation seriously. This is a direct order.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Each phrase distinct and measured. Sharp diction on key words. Steady eye contact. This is not a suggestion — it's a directive. No room for misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員に、本気で、絶対、ノルマ、絶対、押しつける、絶対、ことなく、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're moving forward without imposing quota pressure on the staff. Thank you for the trust.
lines.style: Respectful confirmation delivered with quiet competence. Each point lands deliberately. Controlled pace, no rushing to defend. The tone of someone reporting back to someone who expects results.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、独自の、絶対、歩む、絶対、道、絶対、貫け、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The company needs to carve its own path forward. Stick to that principle.
lines.style: Firm conviction without harshness. Deliberate pace on 'own path.' The voice of someone speaking from experience. Lands hard on the responsibility, not on the person.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様、本気で、絶対、約束を、絶対、破る、絶対、ことなく、絶対、対応しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're honouring commitments to our valued clients without exception. Thank you for this direction.
lines.style: Measured affirmation. Professional warmth underneath — this is a pledge being made. Even delivery, slight weight on 'without exception.' The cadence of someone who understands what's at stake.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 失った市場、本気で、絶対、取り戻し、絶対、戦略、絶対、立てろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The markets we've lost — develop the strategy to reclaim them. Now.
lines.style: Urgent but controlled. Sharp attack on 'lost.' Tempo picks up on 'reclaim.' Brief, muscular phrasing. This carries weight. The kind of directive that shifts focus in a room.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人を、本気で、絶対、引っ張り、絶対、上げる、絶対、メンター、絶対、配置しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're assigning mentors to develop our newer team members. Thank you for your confidence.
lines.style: Steady, professional acknowledgment. Slight warmth on the mentorship note — this is investment, not just orders. Delivered with the quiet confidence of someone executing strategy well.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、過去に、絶対、とらわれ、絶対、ない、絶対、経営しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Run this company forward. Don't be bound by what came before.
lines.style: Penetrating directness. Slow, deliberate opening. Each word carries intent. Slight pause before 'don't' — this is the real point. The voice of someone who sees patterns the room misses.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、競合、絶対、奪う、絶対、シェア、絶対、注視しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're monitoring market share in our competitive landscape closely. Thank you for the mandate.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly more expansive. Professional completion of the exchange. Steady, assured, leaving no doubt the message has been received and understood. The closing note of a successful briefing.
